# Dependencies

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### External services

| Service | Purpose |
|---|---|
| AI providers via `laravel/ai` ^1.3 (drivers in `app/Models/AiProviderDriver.php`: openai, anthropic, gemini, groq, xai, deepseek, mistral, ollama, azure, eleven, …) | Chat streaming (`BrainClient`, `AgentRunner`), intent classification (`IntentClassifier`), structured results, memory hypotheses, embeddings (`EmbeddingService`). Keys stored encrypted in `ai_providers.api_key`; `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY` are fallback (`config/ai.php`) |
| Remote MCP servers via `laravel/mcp` ^1.1 | Connector tool discovery/calls/ping (`app/Services/McpClient.php`, `Client::web()`); HTTP(S) only; `MCP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` (15), `MCP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS` |
| REST / webhook endpoints | Catalogue tools of type `rest`/`webhook` (`app/Tools/HttpToolHandler.php`, `Http::acceptJson()->timeout()`); credential sent as header |
| SMTP (Mailpit locally) | Configured (`MAIL_*`, `compose.yaml` `mailpit`); no `Mail::` call sites in `app/` |
| S3-compatible storage (RustFS locally) | Configured (`AWS_*`, `league/flysystem-aws-s3-v3` ^3.0, `compose.yaml` `rustfs`); no `Storage::` call sites in `app/` |

### Shared infrastructure

| Component | Used for | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| PostgreSQL 18 + pgvector | Primary store; `vector(1536)` HNSW cosine search for memories | `compose.yaml` `pgsql`, `pgvector/pgvector` ^0.2.2, `MemoryRetriever` |
| Redis | Queue connection (`ProcessUserMessage::dispatch()->onConnection('redis')`), cache, sessions, rate limiters, task cancel flags | `compose.yaml` `redis`, `config/queue.php`, `TaskService::cancellationKey` |
| Queue worker | `queue:work redis --queue=tasks,default,low --tries=3 --timeout=960 --max-jobs=500 --max-time=3600` | `compose.yaml` service `queue`, `README.md` |
| Scheduler | `schedule:work`: `jarvis:approvals:expire` (1 min), `jarvis:connectors:health-check` (1 min, no overlap), `jarvis:retention:prune` (daily) | `routes/console.php` |
| Laravel Reverb ^1.12 | WebSocket broadcast on `private-user.{id}`; `REVERB_HOST`/`REVERB_SERVER_HOST` split internal vs public | `compose.yaml` `reverb`, `config/reverb.php`, `resources/js/lib/echo.ts` |
| Observability | Logs via `config/logging.php` (`LOG_CHANNEL`, `LOG_DAILY_DAYS`); job log context middleware `app/Jobs/Middleware/WithLogContext.php`; `GET /up` health (DB, Redis, Reverb via `REVERB_HEALTH_URL`); audit trail `audit_logs` + `jarvis:audit:report`; tail with `laravel/pail` | `app/Support/HealthCheck.php`, `app/Support/AuditLogger.php` |
| Admin UI | Filament ^5 panel at `/admin` (`admin` gate) | `app/Providers/Filament/AdminPanelProvider.php` |
